''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' (Vol. II, p. 97, "''Imperieuse''" - Vol. II, p. 99, "''Incomparable''" - Vol. I, p. 252, "''Falcariae''" - Vol. I, p. 310, "''Galactic Guardian''") systematically stated that starships from ''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]'' were in service two years before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. This indicated that the campaign of ''Star Wars: Empire at War'' was intended to take place, to a certain extent, in 2 BBY.
